title: MedsState
description: State file for the med-reminder OpenClaw skill. One file per user.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when making breaking changes.

meds.description: All tracked medications. One object per med.

tick.description: Optional tick-engine bookkeeping (issue #1). watermark_utc is set once by the history migration; occurrences before it are never enumerated. The tick advances it only past done work and mirrors it into tick-heartbeat.json.

watermark_utc.description: UTC instant of the last completed tick (initially the migration instant).

last_good_timezone.description: Last timezone that resolved successfully; used as a fallback (with an alert) when global.timezone goes bad.

tz_alert_date.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last bad-timezone alert — one alert per day.

schedule_alerts.description: med id → local date (YYYY-MM-DD) of that med's last 'can't process schedule' alert — one alert per failing med per day.

force_nonces.description: Duplicate-override nonces offered by confirm's exit 3: nonce → {med_id, taken_at_utc, expires_utc}. Single-use, 10-minute TTL.

timezone.description: IANA timezone string, e.g. 'America/Los_Angeles'. Required — no system inference.

quiet_hours.description: No reminders sent during this window. Times in local HH:MM (24h).

paused.description: Global pause. When true, all dispatch exits silently regardless of med state.

digest_time.description: Daily digest fires once at this local time.

delivery_channel.description: Messaging channel for outbound reminders, e.g. 'whatsapp', 'telegram', 'sms'. Wire up send-message.sh for your channel.

log_redact.description: Optional privacy switch (issue #1 §7). When true (or MEDS_LOG_REDACT=1), logs use med ids only and sender stderr is redacted.

last_digest_order.description: Med ids in the order today's digest listed them. Written by the tick when it queues the digest; reply.py --position N resolves against it (issue #1 §6).

last_digest_date.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the digest that produced last_digest_order. A --position reply from any other date is refused.

id.description: Stable unique identifier, e.g. 'med-001'. Never reused after deletion.

name.description: Human name used in messages and fuzzy matching, e.g. 'Metformin'.

dose.description: Prescribed dose amount as a string, e.g. '500', '2', '10'.

paused.description: Per-med pause. When true, dispatch skips this med only.

active_since_utc.description: UTC instant the med became active (add, unpause, schedule or timezone edit). Occurrences before it are never enumerated — no phantom misses. Set by reply.py's add/edit commands.

start_date.description: Optional first active local date (YYYY-MM-DD, in global.timezone) — for courses and seasonal meds. Occurrences on earlier local dates are never enumerated. Null/absent = no start bound. Must be <= end_date when both are set.

end_date.description: Optional last active local date (YYYY-MM-DD, in global.timezone) — INCLUSIVE. Occurrences on later local dates are never enumerated and never logged missed (no phantom misses after a course ends). Null/absent = no end bound.

syringe.description: Optional syringe type for the reconstitution calculator (PR 8a, #10). Absent/null = U-100. U-100: 1 unit = 10 µL; U-50: 1 unit = 20 µL. Only used when the dose is in mcg or mg and a mix has been logged (reply.py reconstitute).

min_gap_hours.description: Override for the duplicate-confirm window (issue #1 §4). Default is half the shortest scheduled gap.

frequency.description: How often the med is taken. 'interval' uses interval_hours; others use times[].

times.description: Local HH:MM dose times. Required for once_daily, twice_daily, weekly. Omit for interval/as_needed.

interval_hours.description: Hours between doses. Required when frequency is 'interval'. Null otherwise.

day_of_week.description: Dose day(s) for weekly meds: a single day ('mon', legacy) or a list for multi-day protocols (['tue','sat'], ['mon','tue','wed','thu','fri']). Lists are stored sorted mon..sun and deduped; single strings stay strings for compat reads. Required when frequency is 'weekly' — without it reminders fire daily. Null otherwise.

with_food.description: Whether the med should be taken with food. Informational only — shown in digest.

notes.description: Free-text timing notes shown in the digest, e.g. 'Take with morning meal'.

quiet_policy.description: Interval meds only: 'ignore' fires through quiet hours (default), 'shift' waits for quiet hours to end. Asked at interview (issue #1 §8).

late_threshold_minutes.description: Nudge cadence (#11): a nudge every N minutes after the dose (or a snooze wake) until it is taken, skipped, snoozed, or closed as missed when the next dose is due (at most 25h after it). Default: 30.

missed_threshold_minutes.description: RETIRED (#11) — no longer read; a dose is logged missed when the next dose is due. Still required so older readers load the file. Default: 90.

late_message.description: Message sent on LATE. Supports {name}, {dose}, {unit} template vars.

missed_message.description: Message sent on MISSED. Supports {name}, {dose}, {unit} template vars.

medState.description: Runtime state. Written only through safe_write.py (the tick and reply.py).

status.description: Current dose status. 'deferred' resets to 'pending' at midnight.

last_taken.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last confirmed dose. Null until first confirmation.

last_reminded.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last outbound reminder sent.

next_due.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of next scheduled dose. Set by setup-tasks.py on registration. Recomputed after each confirmation via compute_next_due().

confirmed_dose.description: Scheduled dose occurrence credited by the last confirm. A scheduled event is skipped only when it matches this occurrence, so an early confirm and a same-day second dose are never conflated. Null for interval/as-needed meds; absent in older state files.

missed_count.description: Cumulative missed dose count. Incremented on MISSED, never decremented.

history.description: Last 30 dose events. Oldest trimmed when count exceeds 30.

event.description: What happened. 'late_nudge_sent' records the nudge without confirming the dose.

dose_prescribed.description: The prescribed dose at the time of this event, e.g. '500mg'.

dose_taken.description: Actual dose taken if different from prescribed. Null means same as prescribed.

notes.description: Optional free-text note, e.g. 'took with food', 'felt nauseous'.

timeHHMM.description: 24-hour time string in HH:MM format, e.g. '08:00', '20:30'.

isoDatetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime with timezone offset, e.g. '2026-04-21T08:00:00-07:00'.
